title: Concrete root-limit and scalar-tensor Tate sheaves
statement:
For a scheme S and prime l, construct the inverse limit of the root sheaves, its uniquely specified completed Z_l action, the discrete integral coefficient tensor with its uniquely specified completed action, and its ordinary positive-level finite coefficient reductions. All fifteen declarations are the unchanged constructions formerly owned by lem-pur-twist-sheaf-locally-free. Coefficient sheaves and their scalar maps are those of [def-pur-twist-coefficient-rings]; the underlying root sheaves are [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf].

proof.text: Retain the original actual root tower limit, its coordinatewise scalar action, and the prescribed scalar tensor. The existence-uniqueness lemmas fix all action choices. The generic tensor-pushout action theorem and the coefficient tensor comparison construct the integral completed action; no data are selected from mere existence.
